sentences.text: In the instant petition, petitioners are seeking direction upon the respondents to acquire the land of the petitioners if they so desire by following the due procedure established by law and subsequently pay compensation as per the market value of the land to the petitioners.
It is stated that the petitioners are owners of land falling under Khasra Nos. 327-328 and 359 situated at Village Delina, Baramulla.
The respondents are causing interference and are creating hurdles in the enjoyment of the property owned and possessed by the petitioners.

It is further stated that the respondents 2 to 5 without following procedure, as envisaged under Land Acquisition Act,
are forcibly taking the land of the petitioners without paying compensation on the plea that the petitioner are not in possession of the same.

Learned senior counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners would feel satisfied if the instant petition is disposed of with a direction to respondents 2 to 5 to consider the claim of the petitioners.

Having regard to the submission made by learned senior counsel for the petitioners, instant petition is disposed of with a direction to respondents to consider the claim of the petitioner as projected in Ghulam Rasool Sofi And Ors vs Union Territorry Of J And K And Ors on 9 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/30469951/
1 the writ petition within a period of two months from the date copy of this order, writ petition along with its annexures are served upon them and pass a speaking order thereon after affording an opportunity of being heard to the petitioners.
